legal_name: WT Microelectronics Co., Ltd. (TWSE: 3036), owner of Future Electronics
target_audience: Your target customers are carmakers, industrial companies, network equipment makers, server makers and PC makers, and leaders from each are in Formula 1: Honda (Aston Martin), Siemens (Red Bull), Cisco (McLaren), Hewlett Packard Enterprise (Mercedes) and HP (Ferrari). B2B brands are in the sport to host key clients, show their technology working under pressure and meet buyers worldwide. Teams also introduce partners to each other, to their owners and boards, and run joint activations at forums like CES and Mobile World Congress.
market_overlap: You distribute components from New Taipei City across Asia and, through Future Electronics, bought in 2024, from 170 locations in 44 countries. The Formula 1 calendar aligns with the markets you are present in and expanding into: Shanghai, Miami, Montreal, Austin and Las Vegas.
market_reference: Arrow Electronics, your direct competitor in electronic components distribution, has partnered McLaren since 2019. It is Official Technology Partner of the McLaren Formula 1 Team and title partner of its IndyCar team, its brand is on the cars and drivers, and its engineers work side by side with the race team.
shared_values: A Formula 1 team depends on the right part reaching the right place on time, at every race in the world. WT Microelectronics keeps electronics makers supplied with chips from leading suppliers, with engineers to help design them in.
